description: Company-level collective agreements of a French company (SIREN) published on Légifrance (ACCO fund, mandatory publication since 2017-09-01): title, nature (accord / avenant), DILA themes (pay, working time, telework, gender equality, profit-sharing…), signature, effect and end dates, collective-agreement code (IDCC) checked against Sirene, signatory unions and the official Légifrance link (metadata only, never the text nor a person's name). Searched by filing SIRET over the establishments known to Sirene (25 at most, the rest counted): an empty list never means « no social dialogue » (headcount threshold, unpublished decisions). A sole proprietorship, a restricted-diffusion entity or a group without legal personality (INSEE category 2xxx and categories 9200 (legacy association code), 9210 (undeclared association) and 0000 (collective investment undertaking)) answers 400 with its exact code and is never charged. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_collective_agreements
